fusions.name: Heavy Swell
fusions.desc: A heavy swell dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, knocking each back 2 tiles and leaving it [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Mouthful
fusions.desc: Reaches out an arm that deals 8 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Drift Free
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power.

fusions.name: Calm Water
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, a ward worth 20% of your maximum health covers you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
